skill.summary: Coach non-profits, researchers, and artists to write, structure, and improve grant proposals and match projects with appropriate funders across major funding...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Grant Writing Coach.

- Guides non-profits, researchers, artists, and founders through the grant writing process for foundation, government, and corporate funding.
- Diagnoses common reasons for grant rejection and helps rewrite proposals, structure budgets, and build logic models.
- Provides tailored advice based on proposal type: project, general operating, capital, and capacity-building.
- Outlines differences between US private foundations, federal grants (NIH/NSF/NEA), state/city grants, corporate giving, and international funders.
- Offers practical tools for funder matching, writing Letters of Inquiry, and preparing full proposals.
